_comment: Copy this file to seoul_index_config.json and fill in your own keys. The real config is gitignored and never committed.
_api_key_comment: data.seoul.go.kr general API key (일반인증키). Free: register at https://data.seoul.go.kr and request the 일반 인증키. Every post credits data.seoul.go.kr (CC-BY).
_data4library_comment: Optional. 도서관 정보나루 (https://data4library.kr) authKey. The books harvester IS wired up, but the issued key has returned vitalizationErr on every call so far, so the vein has never produced a post. Leave as-is if unused.
_kosis_comment: KOSIS OpenAPI apiKey (https://kosis.kr/openapi) for the national-contrast lines. Free after registration. The key is a base64 string that includes a trailing '='.
_data_go_kr_comment: 공공데이터포털 (data.go.kr) general service key: MOLIT apartment-market lines, the weather veins, airport, incheon, rail, health, culture and tourism, and 단기예보 조회서비스 (15084084) for the live air temperature on the river cards. One key per account, but each API needs its own 활용신청 (자동승인) before the key works against it.
_hrfco_comment: Optional. 한강홍수통제소 (https://www.hrfco.go.kr) key for the river-level lines. HRFCO issues its own keys; this is NOT a data.go.kr key. They email it and you must click the activation link in that mail, or every call returns {"code":"941"}. Leave as-is if unused: the level vein simply never wakes.
_keychain_comment: The Bluesky app password is NOT stored here. Put it in the macOS Keychain: security add-generic-password -a "your-handle.bsky.social" -s "seoulindex-bluesky" -w
_claude_comment: The claude -p selector authenticates with a long-lived Claude Code setup-token in the Keychain (account 'seoulbot', service 'claude-oauth-token'). Create one with: claude setup-token
